slides.title: Exam season? Keep your speed anyway
slides.sub: About 90 minutes of training a week holds most of it

slides.title: What holds and what fades in a month off
slides.caption: Technique holds. Short hard efforts keep your speed. Aerobic fitness fades first, and comes back fastest.

slides.title: Keep the frequency, cut the volume
slides.body: Two 30 minute sessions a week beat one 90 minute session. Frequency keeps the movement familiar and leaves your evening free for revision.

slides.title: The 30 minute speed session
slides.body: 10 minutes of warm up. 6 to 8 sprints of about 10 seconds from a rolling start, with an easy lap between each. 5 minutes easy to finish.

slides.text: Cut the session, never the sleep.

slides.title: Stopping completely? Look after the skates first
slides.body: Clean and oil the bearings, wipe the frames, rotate the wheels and store everything somewhere cool and dry.
